_comment: Hand-authored RE input for the script-globals subsystem (the despawn-global
MP-cars-in-SP fix). Unlike the native table, these anchors are NOT resolved by
the crossmap join -- they are version-specific machine addresses reverse-
engineered once per game build from the PS5 eboot with a disassembler, then
baked into a generated header by devtools/generators/generate_script_globals_header.py.
Set each anchor's "addr" to the absolute live virtual address (the eboot maps
at its fixed link base with no ASLR slide, so the disassembler vaddr is the
live VA). Leave it null until RE'd; a null anchor emits 0 and the runtime
latches FAILED rather than dereferencing null. See docs/script-globals-design.md.
_targetIdComment: Both the globals base and global indices move between builds; never reuse these values.

despawnGlobalIndex.note: A read-only live bytecode scan on PPSA04264 01.011.001 (PID 101, 2026-11-01) returned exactly one hit, 4521040 (01.010.002: 4520961). The runtime writes only after an explicit vehicle spawn arms the capability.

prologueGlobalIndex.note: Unset for 01.011.001; Skip Prologue remains disabled.

anchors.name: SCRIPT_TABLE
anchors.lead: Not resolved for 01.011.001; production does not consume this anchor (01.010.002 leads do not transfer).
method: Unresolved; null emits 0 and the runtime latches FAILED instead of dereferencing it.

anchors.name: GLOBALS_BASE
anchors.lead: Live-inspected PPSA04264 01.011.001 globals pointer table, relocated from 01.010.002 0x6155e90.
method: 13 of the 14 01.010.002 RIP-relative accessor sites were found in the 01.011.001 normalized executable by exact surrounding bytes (displacement masked); all 13 resolve to 0x618b570.

Fail-closed read-only validation on PID 101 observed 15 plausible pointers and 49 null entries, resolved block 17 for index 4521040, and confirmed the target slot was writable with value 0 without changing it.
